title: Intelligent Intrusion Detection System
summary: A network intrusion detection system that trains a deep learning classifier on the NSL-KDD dataset and exposes a FastAPI backend with real-time traffic monitoring. It vendors an in-tree copy of the CTGAN synthetic-data package (backend/src/CTGAN, backend/api/CTGAN), whose preprocessing module directly imports rdt's ClusterBasedNormalizer and OneHotEncoder to generate synthetic network security data and address class imbalance.
evidence: backend/src/CTGAN/preprocessing/data_transformer.py:5 'from rdt.transformers import ClusterBasedNormalizer, OneHotEncoder'; api.CTGAN.routes imported in main.py
needs: Could not confirm from evidence whether ctgan_router actually invokes training/sampling calls at runtime, only that the vendored module and route are wired into the app.
